slides.title: 2 nd week
slides.body:
August 31st – British Accent Listening & Partner Introduction.
I came a bit late, but I was still within the 15-minute grace period. We started with a listening challenge using a British accent audio. Miss asked us questions about what we heard, and then we practiced writing and speaking by introducing our seatmates. I was paired with Raya and wrote down everything about her. Three classmates presented in front of the class, while the rest of us were asked to make a video introducing our partners. Before leaving, Miss told us to bring a printed family photo for the next session

slides.title: 3 rd week
slides.body:
September 7th – Grammar Correction & Article Rules

Miss arrived a little late today. I brought my printed family photo as instructed. We started with a quick activity: writing down 10 words that describe or remind us of 'Family' (like harmonious, warm, and love). Then, we swapped notebooks with our seatmates and wrote 6 sentences using their words. Miss walked around to check our work, correct grammar mistakes, and help us improve.

After that, Miss explained the rules for using Articles (A, An, The):

'A' and 'An' (Indefinite): Used for general things. We use 'A' before consonant sounds (a family, a photo) and 'An' before vowel sounds (an uncle, an idea).

'The' (Definite): Used for specific things (the photo on the desk) or unique things (the environment).

Pronunciation tip: We pronounce 'the' as 'De' before consonant sounds (the family) and as 'Di' before vowel sounds (the environment)."

slides.title: 4 th week —
slides.body: September 14th – Daily Activities & Adverb of Frequency. We practiced making simple sentences about daily activities using the Simple Present Tense. Miss explained Adverb of Frequency—words like always, usually, often, sometimes, occasionally, rarely, and never, including their levels and positions. She taught us that we place them before the main verb (like 'I always study') and after verb to be (like 'He is usually late'). During class, we created our own sentences and Miss corrected our grammar one by one. For our assignment, we were given 18 simple sentences, and we had to choose at least 10 to change into questions, ask our friends, and record their answers.

slides.title: 5 th week —
slides.body: September 21st – Past Habits & Interactive Quiz We learned the Simple Past Tense to talk about past activities, focusing on positive patterns, negative patterns (did not + Verb 1), and questions (Did + Subject + Verb 1), as well as regular vs irregular verbs. We practiced writing about what we did the day before (Sunday) with direct corrections from Miss. We also learned two additional expressions: 'Used to + Verb 1' for past habits that we don't do anymore, and 'Wanted to be' for childhood dreams! At the end, we played an interactive quiz on the screen filled with blank dots where each vertical row had to raise hands to fill in the blanks. I volunteered to answer, and I got it right on the first try without any corrections

slides.title: 6 th week —
slides.body: September 28th – Public Places, Listening & Classroom Games. We started by choosing 5 of our favorite public places. Then, we did a listening exercise featuring 3 conversations about directions and landmarks. Miss complimented us because our listening skills have improved so much—we answered together confidently and got almost everything right! After writing descriptions of our favorite places, we played a game called 'Describe and Guess' with 2 representatives from each row. One described a place using 3 sentences with 3 banned words, and the other had to guess. For our weekly portfolio, we had to pick 3 public spaces and explain why we like them. I chose a futsal court, a café, and a mountain because they help me refresh my mind! We also formed groups of 4 for our Midterm Project 1, "I love visiting the zoo because I really enjoy seeing wild animals up close, especially tigers and lions. Watching them always excites me, and walking around the zoo is a fun way to spend my free time. 2. The library is one of my favorite places because it is quiet and peaceful. I like reading books, searching for new information, or doing assignments there without any distractions 3. I really enjoy going to the museum because I can learn about history, culture, and interesting objects. Looking at historical displays helps me understand the past and gain new knowledge.

slides.title: 7 th week —
slides.body: October 5th – First Online Class & Midterm Project Details. Because of a campus policy prohibiting offline classes due to heavy haze (smog), we had to study from home. Despite connection issues and unclear audio, we completed a listening practice with 2 conversations about directions and destination times. Miss reminded us about our weekly portfolios and explained our Midterm Group Project (UTS): making a conversation video in groups of 4 with clear speaking, equal member participation, and good audio/visual quality
